request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Hedge Crossbowman".

Creative brief
Name: Hedge Crossbowman
Collection: Ironroad Marauders. Organized highway raiders who turn practical medieval weapons, shields, traps, chains, and stolen supplies into disciplined projectile patterns.
Core concept: A precision sniper that rewards watching its aim direction.
Body and silhouette: Kneeling hooded shooter with a broad crossbow, padded coat, and compact quiver.
Signature features: White aiming cloth tied to the weapon, crank handle, and leafy shoulder camouflage.
Palette and materials: Hedge green, brown cloth, dark wood, and gray steel.
Movement personality: Patient, still, and methodically accurate.
Attack concept: Tracks the player with a bright aim line, locks the line in place, then fires a fast bolt after a brief escape window.
Directional details: The white aiming cloth hangs from the crossbow’s left limb.
Avoid: Firearm silhouette, invisible sniper attack, full ghillie suit.
